method.self_reference_guard: a line describing THIS board (containing any of ledger_state_board / state-board / 状态板 / selftest / NOT_IN_LEDGER / S3-stateboard / 覆盖如实 / spot_check ...) is treated as meta-prose, not data, and is excluded from every field's derivation. This fixes the r1 defect where, after r1's own delivery block was applied to the ledger, the board read 'ORD-0032 ... REJECTED' and 'ORD-9999 -> NOT_IN_LEDGER' out of its own documentation.
method.block_split: a block = a line starting with '### ' up to the next such line
method.recency_rule: the latest block for an order is chosen by the timestamp parsed from the header (full 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' or 'CMDR-MMDD-HHMM'); blocks with no parseable full date are ranked after dated ones (recency is not asserted when the ledger does not state it), ties broken by file position with lower index treated as newer. File position alone is NOT used because the ledger is inserted per-author, not strictly per-time.
method.status_rule: latest_status = the ORDER_STATUS token bound to THIS order's own occurrence ON THE SAME LINE in the newest block that carries such a binding. Binding is following-only within 30 chars and is refused when another order reference (an ORD-0xxx or a bare 4-digit shorthand like 0302) sits between the order and the status. Hyphenated runs are atomic so 'NOT-LANDED'/'OPEN-FOR-CURRENT-TIP' do not match LANDED/OPEN.
method.secret_handling: free-text fields are run through redact(); a KEY/SECRET/TOKEN/... assignment keeps the field NAME and replaces the VALUE with <redacted>
